newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,380 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,380 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 1,380 contracts compared with 5,542 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 89 wheat, 737 corn, 432 soybean, 26 soymeal, 16 soyoil, 10 oat, two rice, one wheat call, 14 corn calls, 14 corn puts, 35 soybean calls and four soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1/2 to 3/4 cent higher and soybeans were two to four cents lower.
